source_versions: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg12+2), Linux arm64, local Compose source profile
required_permissions: SELECT all relations in scan scope
tenant_scope: secret reference binds tenant IDs and exact destination
network_destinations: operator-registered PostgreSQL host and port; local profile source-postgres:5432 only
source_identity_rules: Within an existing registered source/database: database OID + relation OID + column attnum; display paths never identify objects. Database recreation/recycled-OID detection and source epochs remain unimplemented.
pagination: bounded full catalog snapshot, 10000 records / 8 MiB; exceeding bound fails without completion
incremental_cursor_behavior: not implemented; repeatable-read scope-complete snapshots only
retry_classes: site transport transient errors retried through Temporal; source error terminates scan with sanitized code
deletion_strategy: only successful complete manifests qualify; permission fingerprint changes prohibit absence-based deletion

limitations: Bounded schema/table/view/column catalog extraction only; exact local destination and tenant allowlist.
Other PostgreSQL versions, architectures and remote deployment profiles remain unqualified.
Database/cluster recreation and recycled OID detection are not implemented; source-epoch reconciliation remains required and unverified.
